content: {"kind":"plan","text":"按你说的 15 分钟排成 HIIT 循环：低冲击开合跳做心肺主项，波比跳库里没有，用「扶凳上斜俯卧撑 + 徒手深蹲」组合替代它的撑-蹲结构；主训练循环 3 轮，动作间休 15 秒、轮间休 45 秒。场所采用默认的居家，难度采用默认的 1，室内只需垫子、椅子和墙。","plan":{"schemaVersion":1,"source":"ai","title":"15分钟居家HIIT循环","summary":"低冲击开合跳配上深蹲、上斜俯卧撑与平板支撑，共三轮间歇循环，最后拉伸放松。","goal":"fullbody","scene":"home","equipment":["mat","chair","wall"],"level":1,"targetMinutes":15,"avoid":[],"blocks":[{"id":"b1","name":"热身","type":"warmup","rounds":1,"restBetweenRoundsSeconds":0,"items":[{"exerciseId":"h-wall-angel","mode":"reps","sets":1,"reps":10,"perSide":false,"restSeconds":10},{"exerciseId":"n-pelvis-circle","mode":"time","sets":1,"workSeconds":30,"perSide":false,"restSeconds":10},{"exerciseId":"h-squat","mode":"reps","sets":1,"reps":12,"perSide":false,"restSeconds":10}]},{"id":"b2","name":"HIIT 循环","type":"circuit","rounds":3,"restBetweenRoundsSeconds":45,"items":[{"exerciseId":"h-step-jack","mode":"time","sets":1,"workSeconds":40,"perSide":false,"restSeconds":15},{"exerciseId":"h-squat","mode":"reps","sets":1,"reps":15,"perSide":false,"restSeconds":15},{"exerciseId":"h-incline-pushup","mode":"reps","sets":1,"reps":10,"perSide":false,"restSeconds":15},{"exerciseId":"h-forearm-plank","mode":"time","sets":1,"workSeconds":30,"perSide":false,"restSeconds":15}]},{"id":"b3","name":"放松","type":"cooldown","rounds":1,"restBetweenRoundsSeconds":0,"items":[{"exerciseId":"o-stand-quad","mode":"time","sets":1,"workSeconds":30,"perSide":true,"restSeconds":10},{"exerciseId":"h-wall-calf","mode":"time","sets":1,"workSeconds":30,"perSide":true,"restSeconds":10}]}],"notes":["波比跳库里没有，用扶凳上斜俯卧撑加徒手深蹲组合代替；开合跳用低冲击开合跳（不跳起）。","循环 3 轮，动作间休 15 秒，轮间休 45 秒；跟不上就把开合跳降到 25–30 秒。","没提场所和水平，按默认排成居家、难度 1。"],"safetyNotes":["强度以还能说短句为准；出现头晕、胸闷、刺痛立刻停止。","手腕或膝有不适就把上斜俯卧撑改成站姿推墙、深蹲减小幅度；不适加重就停止。"]}}
